method: Read the local inspection function and dispatch, final current-source/manifest binding correction and comparison-scope flag. Checked that credential/network/TeX paths remain absent from this action and commit remains gated. No key, private receipt, PDF/log contents, client, parser, network request, test or compiler was accessed/run by this reviewer.
findings: Before PDF parsing, current validated staged-source digest must match both terminal proof and artifact record, and the proof's status receipt metadata/file-manifest hashes must match current inputs. This prevents relabelling an older preview with the current manifest. Fixed artifact paths, symlink rejection and exact bytes/SHA checks bind the downloaded PDF/log; the reference PDF is covered by the unchanged release preparation check.

The action locally uses pypdf text extraction to compare canonical and remote page counts, NFKC/whitespace-normalized full text and extracted bibliography. It also checks observed BibTeX execution and final-pass undefined-reference diagnostics. Mismatches remain explicit, with a bounded displayed diff in the private result; no successful comparison is assumed by this source review.

The comparison scope is extracted PDF text, page count and bibliography, and visual_layout_review_performed is explicitly false. These checks do not establish rendered-layout identity or re-prove the manuscript's mathematics. The private review record's flags describe only the named comparison, which the coordinator must inspect before any later commit release.

The result is exclusively created mode0600 and fsynced locally. Dispatch returns before credential/network handling. No TeX/compiler/scientific process or remote request is needed. Commit remains hard-disabled; its actual current-revision/preview/unknown-outcome protections remain a separate review.
resolved_findings: Bound the terminal/artifact source and status-receipt hashes to the current metadata and canonical file manifest.
Explicitly distinguished extracted-text checks from visual-layout review.
